question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is '**ceases**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**ceases**" means to bring or come to an end. (समाप्त होना)
 
• In the context of the sentence, "ceases to amaze" means to continually amaze or never stop amazing.
 
• The other options: "**layoffs**," "**actuates**," and "**extenuates**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Go heritage hunting in the nearby quaint townships- Chilika never ceases__ to amaze.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Layoffs (हटाना)**: means to dismiss employees from a workforce, typically due to financial reasons.
 
• **Actuates (सक्रिय करना)**: means to put into action or motion.
 
• **Extenuates (हल्का करना)**: means to make (guilt or an offense) seem less serious or more forgivable.
